workflows.modelResolution: dynamic-memory summarization model with companion-memory feature sampling
workflows.promptContext: changeable authored snapshot active growth and indexed fresh memories
workflows.multipleCalls: first record_growth call is parsed; no provider continuation
workflows.mutationBoundary: validated entries are appended to session companion JSON and saved after the provider call
workflows.failure: warning-only and does not roll back chat or memory

workflows.trigger: after applied growth when at least twelve active changeable facts exist
workflows.modelResolution: dynamic-memory summarization model with companion-memory feature sampling
workflows.promptContext: authored core current core overlays and accumulated changeable facts
workflows.multipleCalls: first consolidate_soul call is parsed; no provider continuation
workflows.mutationBoundary: core additions and retirements mutate one session companion JSON projection before save
workflows.failure: warning-only and does not roll back earlier work

workflows.trigger: explicit companion Soul preview request with authored context and optional current Soul
workflows.definitionsAndChoice: required set_identity set_authored_facts set_baseline_affect set_regulation_style set_relationship_defaults and done tools
workflows.modelResolution: explicit model then configured model then default then first text-capable model; optional distinct fallback model
workflows.promptContext: editable template receives definition description opening context notes and normalized current Soul
workflows.multipleCalls: calls apply sequentially and done stops remaining calls
workflows.mutationBoundary: pure working Soul value is returned and not persisted by the writer
workflows.continuation: up to eight provider iterations with call and result replay
workflows.failure: structured JSON or XML retry occurs only when no usable native calls were produced

boundaryDecisions.decision: lettuce-companions owns typed authored Soul facts growth policy consolidation and relationship defaults; it does not read conversations or invoke models
growth and consolidation are durable idempotent jobs with explicit failure and checkpoints rather than warning-only background calls
growth additions supersession consolidation and retirement apply as one expected-revision companion change set
continuation uses provider-neutral executions and adapter replay rather than manually shaped provider messages
a later provider failure or hard-cap exit without explicit completion returns an incomplete proposal state instead of silently succeeding
ordinary events contain ids stages operation names and safe errors only
all three workflows receive durable cancellation settlement and restart-safe attempt state

includes: typed Soul authored and growth facts
consolidation additions and retirement as one pure change set

scenarios.expected: no provider request and no mutation
empty memories are removed and the bounded fresh prefix is indexed for evidence
authored immutable categories cannot enter ordinary growth
low confidence zero weight invalid policy and invalid validity windows do not mutate state
valid indices become evidence ids and an empty valid mapping falls back to all supplied memory ids
older active same-category same-slot fact receives superseded linkage
current facts cannot replace an active locked fact in the same semantic slot
fewer than twelve active changeable facts skip provider work
core adjustments outside the consolidatable category set are ignored
retirement ids affect active unlocked facts only
core additions and retirements commit together at one expected relationship revision
known text numeric relationship and authored-fact fields seed a complete default working value
affect and regulation clamp to zero through one while closeness trust and affection clamp to negative one through one
historical policy forces locked true
low-confidence authored claims are excluded
operations after done in the same response are not applied
hard cap or later provider failure yields an incomplete proposal unless done was durably admitted
JSON and XML operations obey native declaration argument and call bounds
completed response and memory remain complete while the derived companion job fails visibly and retryably
group companion capability requires explicit participant policy and cannot be silently omitted
